metadata.description: Syntraq — Power up your agents. Diogo Pereira's Claude Code plugins for git, development, knowledge bases and study.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Conventional Commits with GitFlow (commit-push) and pull requests from the repo template (create-pr).

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: implement-change, clean-architecture, write-tests, create-readme and create-agents-md.

plugins.name: knowledge-base
plugins.description: Personal LLM knowledge base: knowledge-base, compile-wiki, capture-note, adr-new, resume, wiki-lint.

plugins.name: study
plugins.description: Study skills on top of a research knowledge base: exam-map, study-summary, mock-exam, solve-exam, correct-attempt, quiz, flashcards, study-plan.

plugins.name: reports
plugins.description: Academic reports: report-review gives feedback only as tracked changes and comments, in Claude Code or inside Word.
